user.title: Diesel Level Thermostat
user.description: Choose the Diesel Heater device this thermostat will control.

telemetry.title: Temperature and safety
telemetry.description: The heater's physical safety telemetry is detected automatically. Choose the temperature used for room control.

error.unsupported_source_device: This device does not expose the required Power, Heater Level, and Running Mode entities.

init.title: Room feedback
init.description: Choose the temperature sensor that controls this thermostat. The heater's interior temperature is selected by default.

data_description.room_temperature: The temperature used to decide when to start, stop, and adjust the heater level.
data_description.room_temperature_offset: A local correction in Celsius applied only by this thermostat. Use a negative value when the selected sensor reads too high.

advanced.title: Advanced controller tuning
advanced.description: These values control level selection and optional safety stops. Set a safety threshold to 0 to disable it.

data_description.min_level: The lowest level used while the thermostat is heating.
data_description.max_level: The highest level the thermostat may request.
data_description.proportional_band: Celsius temperature difference at which the thermostat requests its maximum level.
data_description.cold_tolerance: Celsius temperature below the target required before starting a stopped heater.
data_description.hot_tolerance: Celsius temperature above the target required before stopping a running heater.
data_description.min_on_seconds: Minimum run time after starting before the thermostat may stop the heater.
data_description.min_off_seconds: Minimum off time after stopping before the thermostat may start the heater again.
data_description.min_level_change_seconds: Minimum time between requested heater-level changes.
data_description.min_voltage: Stop the heater below this supply voltage. Set to 0 to disable.
data_description.max_case_temperature: Stop the heater at or above this Celsius case temperature. Set to 0 to disable.
data_description.max_exhaust_temperature: Stop the heater at or above this additional Celsius thermal-safety temperature. Set to 0 to disable.

error.invalid_level_range: Minimum level must not exceed maximum level.
